entries.document: JBL Professional Series Model 4311 Control Monitor information page (manufacturer, jblpro.com). Exact model 4311.
entries.evidence: Components: 300 mm (12 in) LF; 130 mm (5 in) midrange; 36 mm (1.4 in) HF direct radiator; "matched frequency dividing network". Specs: power capacity 75 W continuous program; nominal impedance 8 ohm. No explicit "passive" or "active" wording on either chunk.

fieldResults.note: Manufacturer page lists three transducers (LF, midrange, HF direct radiator).
Passive architecture indicated (dividing network, single power rating, no amplifier) but no explicit passive/active statement. Not promoted under the explicit-wording rule.

entries.document: JBL 4412 Studio Monitor information page (manufacturer, jblpro.com). Exact model 4412.
entries.evidence: "The 4412 is a three-way monitor system"; transducer complement 300 mm (12 in) LF, 125 mm (5 in) midrange, 25 mm (1 in) HF dome; "Dividing Network" section with crossovers 800 Hz and 4.5 kHz; power rating 150 W; nominal impedance 8 ohm. No explicit "passive" or "active" wording.

fieldResults.note: Manufacturer page: three-way system with three transducers.
Passive architecture indicated (dividing network, no amplifier) but no explicit passive/active statement. Not promoted under the explicit-wording rule.
